title: Story premise ENT078: The Plant That Leaned Toward Two Desks
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: It was meant for you. Takeaway/theme: A gift does not always need a single owner.
description: Two quiet office neighbors both try to place a shared decorative paper plant nearer the other as a gift, sliding it back and forth overnight. They finally push their desks into an L shape and set the plant at the shared corner, where its two paper branches point toward both seats.
